name: plus-ultra
description: Issue-first harness for solo product development: product discovery, roadmap, Issue refinement, and Issue-to-PR implementation with human integration guardrails.

interface.shortDescription: Idea to roadmap to Issue to reviewed pull request
interface.longDescription: Five capabilities for a solo developer: new-project turns an idea into an approved product brief and an initialized repository; product owns docs/product.md; roadmap turns direction into GitHub Epics and Stories; refine-issue makes an Issue ready to implement; implement-issue takes that Issue to a tested pull request and stops for human review. Includes lifecycle hooks that block autonomous merges, releases, tags, and default-branch pushes.
defaultPrompt: Use $implement-issue to implement GitHub Issue #<number> end to end.
Use $refine-issue to make GitHub Issue #<number> ready to implement.
